name: Nashi
description: Nashi is a young nezumi from Kamigawa, adopted into Tamiyo's family after his village was burned, who grows into a tinkerer and inventor.

summary.text: Nashi is a young nezumi from Kamigawa, adopted into Tamiyo's family after his village was burned, who grows into a tinkerer and inventor.

bio.text: In flashbacks he was welcomed into Tamiyo's household, befriended Ajani, and remembered fleeing the fire that burned his village as his mother was burned by a man of living flame.
Kaito traveled into the nezumi swamp to find him and learned that the village was burned on Tezzeret's order, and Nashi later shot Tezzeret in Towashi and demanded to know where Tamiyo was.
He climbed Boseiju with Kaito to reach his mother, but Tamiyo attacked and urged him to join Phyrexia, and she was killed, leaving him grieving.
On Thunder Junction he stole an elixir from Obeka using drones loaded with recordings, realizing he was not so different from his mother.
He later vanished into Duskmourn after following his mother's voice to a carved door, and the Wanderer and Niko rescued him from a wickerfolk cage.
In the Valley of Serenity he faced his mother's shade, pulled her scroll from the ghost-trap at her request, and said goodbye to it as Tamiyo dissolved into moonlight.

status.text: Nashi is alive, having escaped Duskmourn to Ravnica and returned to Kamigawa, where he tells children the story of their adventure.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
timeline.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Nashi remembers fleeing the fire as his mother was burned by a man of living flame.
timeline.quote: Mama's on fire, held aloft by a man of living flame.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo comforts the sobbing Nashi and tells Ajani that actions have consequences.
timeline.quote: Actions have consequences,

timeline.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
timeline.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is dead.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

timeline.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
timeline.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

timeline.summary: Following weeks of searching for Tezzeret, Kaito travels into the nezumi swamp to find the child Nashi.
timeline.quote: But the key to finding Tezzeret was with the nezumi.

timeline.summary: A Living Historian's account reveals a nezumi village was burned five years earlier on Tezzeret's order, and the child Nashi survived.
timeline.quote: Nashi listened to the adults whisper the name of the man who ordered the attack.

timeline.summary: Kaito realizes Tamiyo is a planeswalker, and meets her son Nashi.
timeline.quote: "You're a planeswalker."

timeline.summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
timeline.quote: Tell me where she is.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret turns on Nashi's gang and crushes their motorbikes.
timeline.quote: lifting the bikes into the air and then slamming them together with a gruesome crunch

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
timeline.quote: Your mother still lives.

timeline.summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
timeline.quote: That's my mom up there.

timeline.summary: Kaito gives Nashi a repulsor and they climb Boseiju together toward Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: Walk in the direction you want to go.

timeline.summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
timeline.quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
timeline.quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
timeline.quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

timeline.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
timeline.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Nashi practices story magic in the cactus forest with the memory of his mother, but falters when grief breaks his focus.
timeline.quote: Nashi faltered, and the sprout gave a weakened shudder before coiling back into the sand.

timeline.summary: Nashi watches drone footage from the Ironstone train station and recalls a family reunion at an Omenpath, stirring grief for his mother.
timeline.quote: A part of him knew it was unfair to blame the Wanderer for taking away the reunion he might've had with his mother

timeline.summary: Nashi overhears two Slickshots discussing Lilah's magic amplifier and learns of its existence.
timeline.quote: There was an amplifier on Thunder Junction.

timeline.summary: Nashi infiltrates the Voyager Grande and uses a drone to open a locked room on the tenth floor.
timeline.quote: Its metal legs reached into the keyhole, and Nashi heard the click from outside.

timeline.summary: Nashi's hand passes through the bottle, then the room shatters and Obeka appears.
timeline.quote: there was an ogre with blue-gray skin and a ferocious glare.

timeline.summary: Nashi's drone snatches the elixir but Obeka pulls it back with her time magic.
timeline.quote: a chain of golden links thrashed forward, tugging at the air as if it were pulling the drone back through time.

timeline.summary: Nashi tries an invisibility story spell but it falters, and Obeka derides his weakness.
timeline.quote: The elixir doesn't give power, it enhances it—and you clearly have nothing worth strengthening.

timeline.summary: Obeka punches Nashi and her magic flings him back through his own memories.
timeline.quote: until the explosion shattered his reality.

timeline.summary: Nashi relives a memory in which young Nashi, with a homemade bird gadget, is told by Tamiyo not to hide who he is.
timeline.quote: You are Nashi . That is who I'm proud of.

timeline.summary: Nashi wakes to find Obeka and the amplifier gone, and decides to use drones instead of story scrolls.
timeline.quote: Obeka hadn't meant to, but she'd done him a favor.

timeline.summary: Nashi realizes he is not so different from his mother, and finds his magic flows naturally when he loads recordings onto drones.
timeline.quote: Magic bristled at his fingertips, more naturally than ever before.

timeline.summary: Nashi returns to Obeka's office, invisible, and shows her the drone footage.
timeline.quote: Not until he let the invisibility spell drift away.

timeline.summary: Nashi steals the elixir with a copied time illusion, leaving Obeka lunging at an illusion, and escapes over the roof.
timeline.quote: she lunged for Nashi before crashing straight through him and onto the floor.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's voice congratulates Nashi, who celebrates and plans to make her proud.
timeline.quote: "You did it," came Tamiyo's voice in a whisper.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
timeline.quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Nashi has been missing for three months.
timeline.quote: Three months.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
timeline.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
timeline.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
timeline.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Nashi, the smallest captive, silently watching the wickerfolk.
timeline.quote: eyes fixed on the smallest of the rat-people, who sat at the bottom of his cage, arms around his knees

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
timeline.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

timeline.summary: Niko throws a ghost-filled shard at the lead wickerfolk and another that encloses Nashi and carries him out of the cage.
timeline.quote: The second struck Nashi, enveloping him as it flew onward, through the bars of the cage.

timeline.summary: Niko releases Nashi from the shard and the Wanderer embraces him; he pulls away.
timeline.quote: Nashi was suddenly standing there, looking perplexed for only a moment before the Wanderer pulled him into an embrace.

timeline.summary: Nashi asks for help to find his mother after losing most of his crew.
timeline.quote: I've been searching for my mother since I got here

timeline.summary: Nashi refuses to talk to the Wanderer, saying the House took his mother and he will not leave her.
timeline.quote: This house took my mother. We're going to get her back.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

timeline.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
timeline.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

timeline.summary: The Wanderer wakes bound to a post in a larger cavern.
timeline.quote: she was able to shake off the lingering effects of the sedative dust to find herself held up by loops of some white, cottony material, pinning her tightly to a post.

timeline.summary: Niko wakes bound to a chair with the Wanderer and Nashi in a cult chamber hung with chrysalises.
timeline.quote: They still couldn't move their hands or feet.

timeline.summary: Nashi blames himself for leading his Reckoner friends to their deaths.
timeline.quote: I came in here with four of the Reckoners I knew from back home.

timeline.summary: Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears; Nashi calls to her but she turns away.
timeline.quote: When they put it down, the top snapped open, and Tamiyo's shade appeared.

timeline.summary: The head cultist promises Nashi the gift of rebirth in a cocoon.
timeline.quote: His cocoon has been prepared, and he will live eternally in the Devouring Father's service.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees Nashi and gives him a small object, saying he can change his fate.
timeline.quote: You can change your fate

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Nashi the cult has been stealing her stories and she cannot be saved.
timeline.quote: They've been stealing my stories, Nashi

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks Nashi to let her go.
timeline.quote: Let me go.

timeline.summary: Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
timeline.quote: before she dissolved into moonlight and was gone.

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: Nashi says goodbye to his mother's empty scroll and leaves it behind.
timeline.quote: I hope you can rest now.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

relations.note: She adopted him into her family.
relations.quote: He's part of our family now.

relations.note: His orders led to Nashi's village being burned.
relations.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.
"I believe you know of my son, Nashi."

relations.note: the nezumi hid the child from Tezzeret's organization
relations.quote: the nezumi did the only thing they could—they helped the child become a ghost.
Nashi had promised, as soon as he was old enough, he'd help look for Tamiyo, too.
We are family. You are my son.
the scroll containing his mother's living memory had vanished
His mother was very dear to me, and I owe his family a great debt.

relations.note: His mother, who calls him her sweetest boy.
relations.quote: Oh, my sweetest boy, there are stories whose endings can be changed, and those that can't.

pages_say.description: A young nezumi boy whose village was burned and who was adopted into Tamiyo's family on Kamigawa; he befriends Ajani in flashbacks.
A young nezumi tinkerer, Tamiyo's son, who survived the burning of his village.
Tamiyo's son, who promises to help look for her.
A young nezumi and Tamiyo's son who ambushes Tezzeret in Towashi and is spared.
A young nezumi who tries to reach his mother Tamiyo and who survives her fall.
Tamiyo's son, a young inventor who carries on her work of recording stories on Thunder Junction and uses drones to steal an elixir from Obeka.
Tamiyo's son, a child Reckoner who vanished three months ago through a strange door while following what he took for his mother's voice.
The missing child the rescue party came to find; his mother was dear to the Wanderer.
The lost child the Wanderer and Niko came to find.
A child nezumi Reckoner who is rescued from a wickerfolk cage and is determined to find his mother in the House.
A nezumi child who follows his mother's call into the Valley of Serenity.
A nezumi child who confronts his mother's scroll echo, frees her at her request, and returns to Kamigawa.
